data.caption:
King ke naye gaane 'Daddy Cool' mein Shah Rukh Khan aur Kareena Kapoor ne 15 saal baad saath aakar screen par aag laga di! 🔥

🕺 15 saal baad Shah Rukh aur Kareena ek saath dance floor par dikhe
🎶 50 saal purane iconic cult classic song se inspired hai ye track
🎬 Film 'King' ke is track ne aate hi internet par dhoom macha di

Ra.One ke baad sidha Daddy Cool, SRK-Bebo duo never disappoints! 😎

Comment mein batao: Aapka all-time favourite SRK-Kareena gaana kaunsa hai?
